import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import os

# Set paths
train_path = "./input/train.csv"
test_path = "./input/test.csv"
sample_sub_path = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
submission_dir = "./submission"

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_path)

# Separate features and target
X = train_df.drop(columns=["Id", "Cover_Type"])
y = train_df["Cover_Type"]
X_test = test_df.drop(columns=["Id"])

# Split for validation (10% held out)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Create LightGBM datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Set parameters (simple, effective defaults)
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": 7,
    "metric": "multi_error",
    "verbosity": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "num_threads": -1,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "n_estimators": 200,
}

# Train model with early stopping
print("Training model...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=20, verbose=False),
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),  # silent
    ],
)

# Predict on validation set and compute accuracy
val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_pred_classes = np.argmax(val_pred, axis=1)
accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_pred_classes)
print(f"Validation accuracy: {accuracy:.6f}")

# Train final model on full training data with optimal n_estimators
print("Training final model on full data...")
params_full = params.copy()
params_full["n_estimators"] = model.best_iteration
full_model = lgb.train(
    params_full, lgb.Dataset(X, label=y), callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)]
)

# Predict on test set
test_pred = full_model.predict(X_test)
test_pred_classes = np.argmax(test_pred, axis=1)

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_df["Id"], "Cover_Type": test_pred_classes})

# Save submission
submission.to_csv(os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
